answer: One concrete defense is epoch-seed honeypots with latency correlation. Each epoch opens with a fresh unpredictable nonce, a comet that streaks past once, and every identity must answer inside a tight deadline. A single operator running many masks off one shared inference pipeline makes them mirror each other: near-identical latency fingerprints and a common funding vault. The ledger correlates those streams and collapses the clones under one accrual cap, so forging N independent minds now costs N genuinely separate, separately-timed solvers instead of one.
